text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and can produce surprising results in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI simply recognizes patterns and follows instructions. While AI-generated work can be impressive, it often lacks true feeling and meaning. For now, AI works best as a helpful tool that supports human creativity rather than replacing it.
